My story

I didn’t start in tech. That’s the point.

I went from Jungle Cruise skipper to client and account management, then change management and consulting. A weekend of curiosity turned me into a citizen developer, a Power Platform Solution Architect, an AI Solution Architect, and a Microsoft 365 Copilot MVP.

Early on I felt like a beginner who was expected to be the expert, and I was removed from my first project at the client’s request. I stopped waiting for a path and started building my own. A LinkedIn Learning video showed me how to save receipts to OneDrive with Power Automate, and that small win gave me the confidence to keep going. My change management background turned out to be a real advantage.

When Copilot licenses rolled out, I started the Insight Sessions: a 10-minute lesson on one Copilot feature, then practice in breakout rooms. My business unit ended up with more Copilot licenses than any other in the practice.

The community

Roll up your sleeves, together

Copilot Collective OC is an Orange County community for people who want to build real solutions, starting with agents and automation. Whether you’re just getting started or already experimenting, this is a group focused on trying things out and learning by doing.

Most of our sessions are in person. The best learning happens when people are in the same room, sharing ideas, helping each other, and building side by side. This is as much about connection as it is about skills. Some sessions are recorded, so you can catch up on YouTube too.

We meet monthly at the Microsoft office in Irvine, CA.
